question: Why does Bonney look like she's in her 20s, when she's really 12? Will she stay 12 from now on? Tamago
answer: When she was out at sea, nobody would take a child captain seriously, and looking older was convenient for her journey to find her father. But on the Sunny and Elbaph, it looks like she feels safe enough to remain a child. Please keep an eye on her future developments.
name: Nama Tamago
